payload.checklist: AOA≤12°/≥200kt → EPU ON → 추력↑(HYDRAZN 소등) → MAIN PWR BATT→MAIN → ELEC CAUTION RESET → HOOK DN → C&I BACKUP → Land ASAP AOA 11° → LG DN(DN LOCK REL)/ALT GEAR ≤190kt → 케이블 → 주차브레이크·MAIN PWR 유지
